from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityReport(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from one university's Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university or college")
    report_term: str | None = Field(description="The reporting term, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    student_faculty_ratio: float | None = Field(description="The numeric student-to-faculty ratio value extracted from the report")
    undergraduate_class_sections: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate class sections reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[UniversityReport]
